about_short_description.short_description: Anunta is an industry recognized managed desktop as a service and digital workspace solutions provider.

product.name: Enterprise DaaS
product.description: A cloud-based desktop-as-a-service solution designed for large organizations to deliver virtual desktops and applications securely and at scale.

product.name: Packaged DaaS
product.description: A pre-configured desktop-as-a-service solution aimed at businesses seeking a ready-to-use virtual desktop environment with simplified deployment.

product.name: Managed Endpoint Services
product.description: Services that manage and secure endpoint devices throughout their lifecycle, including monitoring, maintenance, and security enforcement.

product.name: Modern Desktop Management
product.description: A service for managing and securing modern desktop environments, including OS updates, application management, and user experience optimization.

product.name: Mobile Device Management (MDM)
product.description: A solution to manage, secure, and monitor mobile devices used within an organization, ensuring compliance and data protection.

product.name: Device Lifecycle Management
product.description: Management of the entire lifecycle of IT devices from procurement through retirement, including security and compliance controls.
